title: An Audience with the King: Tribute, Atlas Reveal and Current 0.5 Use
summary: An Audience with the King is the current 0.5 Ritual access item. Unspent Ritual Tribute feeds the Tribute to the King bar; when it fills you receive the item. With it in your main inventory, a reveal button appears at a random Atlas location - complete the adjacent map and the button consumes the Invitation to reveal the Crux of Nothingness, the arena of the King in the Mists. Petition Splinters are disabled in 0.5 and only historical.
description: How An Audience with the King works in Path of Exile 2 0.5: Tribute to the King bar, Atlas reveal of the Crux of Nothingness, the King in the Mists fight, and the disabled legacy Petition Splinter flow.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team

sections.title: Quick answer
sections.callout: An Audience with the King is the current 0.5 Ritual invitation. Unspent Ritual Tribute flows into the Tribute to the King bar; when it fills you receive the item. Keep it in your main inventory and a reveal button appears at a random Atlas location. Complete the adjacent map, then the button consumes the Invitation and reveals the Crux of Nothingness - the arena of the King in the Mists. Petition Splinters are disabled in 0.5 and only historical.
calloutDetail: The reveal is a random Atlas node, not a fixed spot at Caer Tarth and not a Realmgate - older guides that say 'feed it to the Realmgate' describe the legacy flow.
The item is not tradeable, so you must earn it through Rituals; do not trust listings claiming to sell it.

answers.label: Use for
text: Revealing the Crux of Nothingness to fight the King in the Mists, farm Omens and Fracturing Orbs, and progress toward the Rite of the Nameless.

answers.label: Check first
text: The item is in your main inventory, the Tribute to the King bar has filled, and you are viewing the Atlas where the reveal button spawns near a completed map.

answers.label: Avoid
text: Expecting a fixed Caer Tarth button or a Realmgate, and confusing this with the Head of the King (which comes from killing the boss, not from Tribute).

sections.title: How to get An Audience with the King
intro: You do not drop or buy this item - it is generated by the Ritual mechanic once you bank enough unspent Tribute.

routes.label: Run Ritual altars in maps
body: Complete Ritual encounters (force more altars with Ritual Tablets - up to six per map). Each altar banks Tribute you can spend in the reward window or defer.

routes.label: Let Tribute flow to the King
body: Tribute you do not spend is offered to the King and fills the Tribute to the King bar. When the bar fills, you are granted An Audience with the King. The exact threshold is pending in-game verification, so treat leftover Tribute as the path to the item rather than chasing a fixed number.

routes.label: Repeatable, not a one-time quest
body: Unlike the fixed quest version of some pinnacle bosses, the Audience is a repeatable endgame invitation: every time the Tribute bar fills you can earn another one.

sections.title: Where and how to use the Audience

steps.label: Hold the item in your main inventory
body: The reveal only triggers while An Audience with the King is on your character. It will not work from a stash or Extra Inventory tab.

steps.label: Open the Atlas and watch for the reveal button
body: With the item in your bag, a reveal button appears at a random Atlas location - typically next to a map you have already completed. It is not pinned to Caer Tarth.

steps.label: Complete the adjacent map
body: The button becomes usable once the neighbouring map is cleared. Run that map (a Tier 14+ Waystone is recommended for the level-80 Crux arena) so the node is active.

steps.label: Trigger the reveal
body: Interact with the button to consume the Invitation. This reveals the Crux of Nothingness, a boss arena node on the Atlas.

steps.label: Fight the King in the Mists
body: Enter the Crux of Nothingness and defeat the King in the Mists. He drops a Head of the King and valuable loot (Omens, uniques). The Head of the King is a separate item used to start the Rite of the Nameless - do not confuse it with the Audience.

before: In the legacy Ritual flow, access ran through Petition Splinters and a Realmgate. Those steps no longer apply to the current version.
after: In 0.5 the Audience is earned from the Tribute to the King bar and consumed at a random Atlas reveal node to open the Crux of Nothingness.
compare.note: The current flow moves access entirely onto the Atlas rather than a fixed Realmgate.

sections.title: Current 0.5 flow vs legacy Ritual access
paragraphs: In the current 0.5 (Runes of Aldur) Ritual, An Audience with the King is produced by the Tribute to the King bar and consumed at a random Atlas reveal node to open the Crux of Nothingness, where the King in the Mists awaits. The item is bound to your account (not tradeable) and repeats every time the bar fills.

The old Ritual access chain - built around Petition Splinters and a Realmgate - is disabled in 0.5. Petition Splinters serve only as a historical reference now; any guide telling you to collect or insert them is describing the legacy system. Likewise, instructions to 'feed the Audience into the Realmgate' reflect the old flow and should not be followed for 0.5.

One more distinction players mix up: the Head of the King is not the Audience. The Head drops from killing the King in the Mists inside the Crux and is the key to the Rite of the Nameless, a separate progression step. The Audience is what gets you into the fight in the first place.
bullets: Current 0.5: Tribute bar -> Audience -> random Atlas reveal -> Crux of Nothingness.
Legacy: Petition Splinters + Realmgate - disabled, historical only.
Head of the King: a separate drop from the boss, used for the Rite of the Nameless, not the Audience.

sections.title: What works in 0.5 vs what does not
note: An Audience with the King is the only current 0.5 Ritual invitation. The legacy Petition Splinter no longer functions.

items.label: Item in main inventory
checks: An Audience with the King must be on your character, not in a stash or Extra Inventory tab.
items.why: The Atlas reveal only triggers while the item is on your person.
items.fix: Move it into your main bag before opening the Atlas.

items.label: Tribute bar actually filled
checks: Confirm you were granted the item from the Tribute to the King bar, not just holding Tribute.
items.why: Only the granted item reveals the Crux; raw Tribute does not.
items.fix: Keep banking unspent Tribute until the bar grants the Audience.

items.label: Adjacent map cleared
checks: The reveal button activates after the neighboring map is completed; a Tier 14+ Waystone is recommended for the level-80 arena.
items.why: An unfinished neighbour leaves the node inactive.
items.fix: Run the adjacent map first, then use the button.

items.label: Not the Head of the King
checks: Make sure you are holding the Audience, not a Head of the King from a previous kill.
items.why: The Head starts the Rite of the Nameless; it does not reveal the Crux.
items.fix: Earn a fresh Audience from the Tribute bar for the reveal.

entries.question: I already have an Audience, but there is no button anywhere on the map.
summary: A player held the item but could not find any reveal option.
editorialAnalysis: The button spawns at a random Atlas node and only becomes usable after the adjacent map is cleared. If the item is in an Extra Inventory tab, or the neighbouring map is unfinished, no button appears. It is also not at a fixed Caer Tarth spot.
officialAnswer: Keep the Audience in your main bag, clear the map next to where the button appears, then use the random Atlas reveal node.

entries.question: Should I buy the Audience or spend Tribute on rewards first?
summary: Players wonder whether to cash out Tribute or push it toward the King.
editorialAnalysis: Leftover, unspent Tribute flows into the Tribute to the King bar. Spend Tribute on items you need now, but any remainder still contributes toward an Audience - you do not have to choose one or the other exclusively.
officialAnswer: Spend Tribute on valuable rewards, and let whatever remains fill the Tribute to the King bar for the Audience.

entries.question: Is the Petition Splinter still worth anything?
summary: Players ask whether old Petition Splinters have use.
editorialAnalysis: Petition Splinters are disabled in 0.5 and are historical only. They are not part of the current Ritual access chain and cannot be converted through the current flow.
officialAnswer: No - Petition Splinters are disabled in 0.5; use the Tribute to the King bar instead.

entries.description: A full 0.5 Ritual walkthrough covering the rework, Tribute to the King, the Audience, and the Crux of Nothingness reveal.
entries.takeaway: Bank unspent Tribute into the Tribute to the King bar, then reveal the Crux of Nothingness from the Atlas while holding the Audience.

problems.symptom: No reveal button on the Atlas
directAnswer: The button appears at a random Atlas node and only after the adjacent map is cleared. It also requires the Audience to be in your main inventory, not an Extra Inventory tab.
checks: Confirm the item is in your main bag, then clear the map next to the node where the button shows up.

problems.symptom: I revealed the Crux but died inside
directAnswer: Death costs the map run and its uncollected loot. Whether the Audience is re-consumed on failure is pending in-game verification, so plan as if each reveal spends one Audience until confirmed otherwise.
checks: Cap chaos resistance and bring mobility before entering the Crux of Nothingness, and do not over-invest the map.

problems.symptom: I have a Head of the King but no reveal
directAnswer: The Head of the King is a separate drop from the boss used to start the Rite of the Nameless; it does not reveal the Crux. You need a fresh Audience from the Tribute bar for that.
checks: Earn an Audience via unspent Tribute, then use the Atlas reveal node.
